_doc: tools/import_frames.gd: Tanko's in-match side view, a template copied from Rookie's (art_source/characters/rookie/side_run/import.json): the run cycle frame_1.png .. frame_N.png here (any size, transparent background, facing right) and the ready pose ../side_ready/ready_v1.png. Run: $GODOT --headless --path . -s tools/import_frames.gd -- tanko. Rookie's numbers tuned for his pictures: retune height, poses.ready.scale and add alignX / hands / gun / hand (see Rookie's config) when this character's pictures need them. See assets/README.md.

draw._doc: the ready pose, shown at once while the gun is out (gunDraw: no transition)

fire._doc: the shot from the ready pose: its frame with the recoil (the hugged gun kicks back along its axis by the flash)

gun._doc: angle per frame is added to the hold (+ = muzzle down). The gun is holstered in idle / walk in the match; carry: where it would be held (px from the feet pivot, source px). fists (optional, Rookie's config): the near fist per source frame, to sway the gun with the arm.

gunDraw._doc: gun_draw.gd TIMINGS overrides: the ready pose switches in and out at once

ready._doc: pose px: kneeling, facing right, both fists together in front of the chest, NO gun, on a flat green backdrop (keyed out: `background`; small detached pieces such as an AI sparkle go, keepPieces). scale: source px per pose px (Rookie's 0.555 for an 882x1024 pose next to 1280x720 run frames: the cap and the head as wide as in the run frames). Without alignX the pose's middle sits on the hips; set gun.grip [x, y] (pose px) to the middle of the fists: the hug point (else the pose's middle). The hug gun is placed by hand in `scene`.
